Character 1 stands in a turning three-quarter pose, with the near boot pinning the edge of her own long shadow on a single abstract plane. The rest of that shadow rises diagonally into an immense black-violet demonic claw behind and beside her. Her raised open palm meets one broad finger of that claw, as though calmly accepting power from a much greater presence. Her other arm rests near the hip instead of pressing her chest. A thin restrained dark-red line connects the dim glow near her heart to the palm contact point, suggesting a cost while the large black claw gathers power. Her face remains unmoved: relaxed brows, steady eyes and a small neutral closed mouth. The cape sweeps opposite the raised arm and the low braid follows the shoulder turn. Show the complete connected figure from hair to both grounded boots. Her face, palm contact and pinned shadow form one upward diagonal. The close dark claw creates scale and foreground overlap without covering her face. Surround them with quiet subdued charcoal, desaturated violet and a small deep-burgundy abstract field, choosing value separation so the black robe, claw, pale face and hair remain distinct. The demonic presence is a single abstract claw, not another humanoid body.

A complete illustration with the freshness of a painted sketch, not an unfinished draft. Soft directional light reveals the planes of forms. Preserve deliberate brush marks instead of smoothing every surface.
